what: Each letter hides −3em to the left inside its own mask cell, attached to its left edge (120% tall, generously open to the right), then slides into place over .75s with cubic-bezier(.16,1,.8,1). The delay is the letter’s index within the word × a step (default .001s, hero .04s), so every word is wiped in from its left letters first. Plays once when visible, or right on open, or via the ‹fx:play› and ‹fx:reset› events (.8s after the menu panel has risen).

options.play: ‹view› (default, once when it enters at −5% from the screen bottom) · ‹load› (right on open) · ‹event› (fire fx:play on the element to bring it in, fx:reset hides it — menu items)
options.each: Delay (s) between letters within a word, default .001
options.fx:done: Fires from the element once all have entered

use: Your Private Jet Charter
note: Letters are grouped into word chunks (inline-block) and the spaces between words are left as is. The mask box is 120% of the text height so descenders (g, y) aren’t clipped
